idempotency_rerun.evidence: The chain is not idempotent on either side and must not be: a second run on the same as_of schedules the next attempt number. What was reruns-proven is that the target reproduces that legacy rerun behaviour. Both sides were executed twice per as_of in one rolled-back transaction (runhistory_equivalence.json, executions=2): run 2 wrote attempt_no 2 and 3 with ids 70e0e4d2-99b7-47b3-9a09-37a6cc57dde0 and bdeccf71-00a7-7207-c613-a30b243c2176 on both sides, row for row, and the suspension sweep wrote nothing further on either side.
